notes: The Hebrew gloss note (*Hebrew strengthened*) was read and set aside; the printed *stiffened*/*hardened* is what is aligned (rule 38).
*also* here answers to the present `גַם`, not to the waw, which takes its own *And* (rule 11).
The assimilated `[הַ]` before `מֶּלֶךְ` is `unrepresented`; the ASV writes *against king Nebuchadnezzar* bare.
